rules.description: Only the bridge entrypoint and the funnel-owned deferred timer may start committed post-edit work.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Function {name:'processCommittedEdit'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/compiled-edit-funnel.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

rules.description: Only cloud, linked-window, and durable-outbox adapters may apply remote Yjs updates to the bridge.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Method {name:'applyRemoteUpdate'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/patch-sync-engine.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path

rules.description: Steady-state Rust worker document updates enter through the bridge-owned forwarding boundary.
rules.query: MATCH (caller)-[:CodeRelation {type:'CALLS'}]->(sink:Method {name:'forwardWorkerYjsUpdate'}) WHERE sink.filePath = 'webapp/js/font-manager.ts' AND NOT caller.filePath STARTS WITH 'webapp/tests/' RETURN caller.name AS caller_name, caller.filePath AS caller_path
